mechanism: Strongest single-gene drop when MCF-7 cells leave 0.5% O2; HIF-1 induces NDRG1 in hypoxia and MYC recovery plus loss of HIF drive it down, which Lai showed increases migration.
CA9 is among the most O2-sensitive HIF-1 transactivation targets (membrane carbonic anhydrase for acidic hypoxia); mRNA and protein collapse once HIF-1α is hydroxylated and degraded.
evidence: canonical HIF; Godet uses CA9 as acute not memory marker

mechanism: GLUT1 is a direct HIF-1 target that raises glucose uptake under hypoxia; reoxygenation restores PHD/VHL control of HIF and GLUT1 transcription falls as glycolysis demand drops.
HIF-1/2 bind HREs in VEGFA and drive angiogenesis while O2 is limiting; the transcript falls as HIF protein is destroyed within minutes of O2 return.
HIF-1 induces LDHA so pyruvate is fermented to lactate instead of entering mitochondria; when O2 returns, HIF falls and LDHA mRNA declines as OXPHOS resumes.
HIF-1 transcribes PDK1, which phosphorylates PDH and blocks pyruvate entry into the TCA cycle; reoxygenation removes that brake so PDK1 expression reverses.
evidence: canonical HIF / Kim et al. PDK1

mechanism: HIF-1 induces BNIP3 to trigger mitochondrial autophagy and limit ROS during hypoxia; the gene turns off as HIF-1α is degraded on reoxygenation.
PHD3 is itself a HIF target and a primary O2-dependent proline hydroxylase; enzymatic activity jumps immediately with O2 (HIF destruction) while EGLN3 mRNA later falls as HIF transcription shuts off.
PHD2 is the main HIF-1α hydroxylase in normoxia; O2 restores hydroxylation/VHL ubiquitination of HIF-1α within minutes, and EGLN1 mRNA (also HIF-inducible) then normalizes.
PGK1 is a direct HIF-1 glycolytic enzyme gene used in classic hypoxia metagenes; transcription tracks HIF activity and therefore falls on reoxygenation.
Enolase-1 is HIF-induced in the lower glycolytic arm; it recedes with HIF as cells leave anaerobic glycolysis.
Aldolase A is a HIF-1 HRE gene in glycolysis; expression drops when HIF-1α protein is cleared.
Adrenomedullin is a HIF-1-induced vasodilatory/survival peptide; mRNA follows HIF and is a consistent member of mouse HIF-1α target lists.
HIF-1/2 induce ANGPTL4, which promotes vascular leak and invasion in hypoxia; transcription reverses as HIF falls unless a separate memory program holds.
HIF-1 induces collagen prolyl hydroxylase P4HA1 to remodel ECM under hypoxia; the gene is hypoxia-metagene core and should fall on reox.
DEC1/BHLHE40 is a direct HIF-1 target that represses circadian and differentiation genes in hypoxia; it declines as HIF activity ends.
HIF-1 induces MXI1 to antagonize MYC during hypoxia; on reoxygenation MXI1 falls and MYC function returns (Lai linked this axis to NDRG1).
HIF and MXI1 suppress MYC in hypoxia; Lai saw C-MYC/N-MYC protein rise as NDRG1 fell during reoxygenation, restoring growth and migration programs.
Reoxygenation produces a superoxide/H2O2 burst; NRF2 and residual HIF can induce HO-1 to catabolize heme and quench ROS, so HMOX1 often rises while HIF glycolytic genes fall.
ERO1L is a HIF-1-induced ER oxidoreductase used in hypoxia signatures; it should recede with HIF once disulfide-load stress of hypoxia eases.
ANKRD37 is a small HIF-1 HRE gene that tracks HIF activity tightly in many hypoxia signatures and is expected to drop quickly on reox.
PAI-1 is a HIF-1 target that inhibits fibrinolysis and supports invasion; transcription should fall with HIF unless EMT memory persists.
HIF-1 induces lysyl oxidase to crosslink collagen and pre-metastatic niches; mRNA is hypoxia-driven and should reverse with HIF.
CITED2 is HIF-induced and competes with HIF for CBP/p300, a negative-feedback brake; it falls as HIF transcription shuts off.
NQO1 is a canonical NRF2/ARE quinone reductase induced by the reoxygenation ROS burst rather than by HIF itself.
MnSOD detoxifies superoxide generated when ETC restarts; Godet found SOD enzymes part of MUC1-C memory, so SOD2 may stay high if cells are persistent rather than fully reverting.
The direct O2 effect is PHD hydroxylation and VHL degradation of HIF-1α protein (minutes); HIF1A mRNA is a poor reversion marker and may change only modestly.
Godet: MUC1-C is HIF-1 and NF-κB induced under chronic hypoxia and was the 6-gene panel member that stayed up after 10 d reox; a falling HIF score with high MUC1 argues memory, not full reversion.
